typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Subscriber as string,
		CallDate as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select Subscriber,CallDate from dbo.NHLCallData where 	(Pregnant = \'X\' or HighRisk = \'X\') and	PatientGender = \'F\' and 	CallDate between DateAdd(dd, -2, ?)  and DateAdd(dd, -2, GetDate())',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> NurseHelpLineData
NurseHelpLineData derive(CodeType = 'NHL') ~> AddCodeType
AddCodeType derive(CodeType = CodeType) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		OB_MEMBERCODES_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_CODE_TYPE as string,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_CODE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		OB_MEMBERCODES_MEMBERNUMBER = Subscriber,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_CODE_TYPE = CodeType,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_CODE_DATE = CallDate)) ~> PDSOBMEMBERCODESSTAGING
